body:
We have:

> The relative security strengths for various cryptographic systems are in this table (from NIST SP 800-57 Part 1, p.71): […]

Proposed addition from Bart Preneel:

> Note: this section assumes that no longer quantum computer exists; if such a computer would exist, the estimates for the last 3 columns would be no longer valid.

comments.body: "no longer quantum computer exists" is somewhat ambiguous to me.
I think his point seems clear here
